        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

context_size)\n+        end = min(len(lines), index + context_size + 1)\n+        results.append(\n+            {\n+                \"line_number\": line_number,\n+                \"line\": line,\n+                \"section\": _section_name_for_line(section_spans, line_number),\n+                \"subheading_path\": _subheading_path_for_line(section_spans, line_number),\n+                \"context_before\": [\n+                    {\"line_number\": item + 1, \"line\": lines[item]}\n+                    for item in range(start, index)\n+                ],\n+                \"context_after\": [\n+                    {\"line_number\": item + 1, \"line\": lines[item]}\n+                    for item in range(index + 1, end)\n+                ],\n+            }\n+        )\n+    return {\"query\": query, \"results\": results}\n*** End Patch\n"
}

  "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: agent_kit/body.py\n@@\n def _section_boundaries(text: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, str, str]]:\n     boundaries: list[tuple[int, int, str, str]] = []\n     offset = 0\n     fence: str | None = None\n@@\n         offset += len(line)\n     return boundaries\n+\n+\n+def _section_line_spans(text: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:\n+    headings = _heading_infos(text)\n+    top_level = [heading for heading in headings if heading[\"level\"] == 2]\n+    spans: list[dict[str, object]] = []\n+    total_lines = _line_count(text)\n+    for index, heading in enumerate(top_level):\n+        next_start = (\n+            int(top_level[index + 1][\"line_number\"])\n+            if index + 1 < len(top_level)\n+            else total_lines + 1\n+        )\n+        spans.append(\n+            {\n+                \"name\": heading[\"name\"],\n+                \"line_start\": heading[\"line_number\"],\n+                \"line_end\": max(int(heading[\"line_number\"]), next_start - 1),\n+                \"headings\": [\n+                    item\n+                    for item in headings\n+                    if int(heading[\"line_number\"]) <= int(item[\"line_number\"]) < next_start\n+                ],\n+            }\n+        )\n+    return spans\n+\n+\n+def _nested_subheadings(\n+    section_spans: list[dict[str, object]],\n+    line_start: object,\n+    line_end: object,\n+) -> list[dict[str, object]]:\n+    section = next(\n+        (\n+            span\n+            for span in section_spans\n+            if span[\"line_start\"] == line_start and span[\"line_end\"] == line_end\n+        ),\n+        None,\n+    )\n+    if not section:\n+        return []\n+    headings = [\n+        dict(item)\n+        for item in section[\"headings\"]  # type: ignore[index]\n+        if int(item[\"level\"]) > 2\n+    ]\n+    for index, heading in enumerate(headings):\n+        next_line = int(line_end) + 1\n+        for candidate in headings[index + 1 :]:\n+            if int(candidate[\"level\"]) <= int(heading[\"level\"]):\n+                next_line = int(candidate[\"line_number\"])\n+                break\n+        heading[\"line_count\"] = max(1, next_line - int(heading[\"line_number\"]))\n+        heading[\"children\"] = []\n+\n+    roots: list[dict[str, object]] = []\n+    stack: list[dict[str, object]] = []\n+    for heading in headings:\n+        while stack and int(stack[-1][\"level\"]) >= int(heading[\"level\"]):\n+            stack.pop()\n+        if stack:\n+            stack[-1][\"children\"].append(heading)  # type: ignore[index, union-attr]\n+        else:\n+            roots.append(heading)\n+        stack.append(heading)\n+    return roots\n+\n+\n+def _heading_infos(text: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:\n+    headings: list[dict[str, object]] = []\n+    fence: str | None = None\n+    for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):\n+        stripped = line.strip()\n+        if fence:\n+            if stripped.startswith(fence):\n+                fence = None\n+            continue\n+        fence_match = _FENCE_RE.match(line)\n+        if fence_match:\n+            fence = fence_match.group(1)\n+            continue\n+        match = ANY_SECTION_HEADING_RE.match(line)\n+        if not match:\n+            continue\n+        headings.append(\n+            {\n+                \"level\": len(match.group(1)),\n+                \"name\": match.group(2).strip(),\n+                \"line_number\": line_number,\n+            }\n+        )\n+    return headings\n+\n+\n+def _section_name_for_line(section_spans: list[dict[str, object]], line_number: int) -> str:\n+    for section in section_spans:\n+        if int(section[\"line_start\"]) <= line_number <= int(section[\"line_end\"]):\n+            return str(section[\"name\"])\n+    return _PREAMBLE\n+\n+\n+def _subheading_path_for_line(section_spans: list[dict[str, object]], line_number: int) -> list[str]:\n+    for section in section_spans:\n+        if not (int(section[\"line_start\"]) <= line_number <= int(section[\"line_end\"])):\n+            continue\n+        path: list[str] = []\n+        for heading in section[\"headings\"]:  # type: ignore[index]\n+            if int(heading[\"level\"]) <= 2 or int(heading[\"line_number\"]) > line_number:\n+                continue\n+            while len(path) >= int(heading[\"level\"]) - 2:\n+                path.pop()\n+            path.append(str(heading[\"name\"]))\n+        return path\n+    return []\n*** End Patch\n"
}

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

\"req_resolve\",\n+                },\n+                {\"final_text\": \"Resolved.\", \"provider_request_id\": \"req_resolved\"},\n+            ]\n+        ),\n+        model_id=\"fake\",\n+    )\n+    assert resolve_turn.outcome == \"completed\"\n+    assert store.load_feedback(observation[\"id\"])[\"resolved_at\"] is not None\n+\n+    resolved_reload_model = FakeModel(\n+        script=[{\"final_text\": \"Loaded resolved.\", \"provider_request_id\": \"req_resolved_reload\"}]\n+    )\n+    run_turn(\n+        epic_id=None,\n+        input=\"reload after resolution\",\n+        store=store,\n+        model=resolved_reload_model,\n+        model_id=\"fake\",\n+    )\n+    assert resolved_reload_model.calls[0][\"hot_context\"][\n+        \"unresolved_observations\"\n+    ] == []\n+\n+\n+def _tool_names(store: SQLiteStore) -> list[str]:\n+    return [\n+        row[\"tool_name\"]\n+        for row in store._conn.execute(\n+            \"SELECT tool_name FROM tool_calls ORDER BY rowid\"\n+        ).fetchall()\n+    ]\n+\n+\n+def _tool_row(store: SQLiteStore, tool_name: str):\n+    row = store._conn.execute(\n+        \"SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_name = ? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1\",\n+        (tool_name,),\n+    ).fetchone()\n+    assert row is not None\n+    return row\n*** End Patch\n"

# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

If a test fails and its ID appears in baseline_test_failures, it is pre-existing — do not scope-creep into fixing it. If baseline_test_failures is null, the baseline could not be captured; use your judgment but err on the side of assuming failures are regressions. You MUST still re-run the FULL test suite with your changes applied — pre-existing failures do not excuse skipping verification. Never narrow to individual test functions and stop.
        - If this batch includes the final verification task, write a short script that reproduces the exact bug described in the task, run it to confirm the fix resolves it, then delete the script.

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

        Idea:
# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler

# Sprint 2b — Editorial polish

Thoughtful behaviors that distinguish a real editorial assistant from a body editor. Adds feedback system, end-of-turn checks, search tools, and agent observations.

**Full spec is at `planning-bot-spec.md` in this repo root. Refer to How to Work Each Checklist Item, Feedback System, End-of-Turn Checks, Communication Style, Persona sections.**

## Supabase
- URL: https://yhwflvadmefhkshwbfnf.supabase.co
- Service key: [REDACTED_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_JWT]

## Scope

- Table: feedback (single table for user feedback AND agent observations)
- Per-item depth guidance in system prompt for all 18 checklist items
- End-of-turn checks — five categories (no message sent, no tool calls, empty response, body unchanged when expected, checklist stall)
- Show-changes pattern in responses
- `search_in_body` tool — returns line numbers + surrounding context + section attribution
- `get_body_outline` tool — section names + line counts
- Feedback tools: save_feedback, apply_feedback, deactivate_feedback, list_feedback
- Agent observation tools: record_observation, list_observations, mark_observation_resolved
- Hot-context loading of active style + process feedback with last_applied_at AND recent unresolved observations
- Agent-proposed-user-confirmed flow for saving feedback
- Agent-only flow for observations (no user confirmation)

## Feedback Table
id, kind (style|process|epic_specific|friction|ambiguity|tool_failure|confusion|pattern_noticed), content, source (user_volunteered|agent_proposed_user_confirmed|explicit_save_request|agent_observation), source_message_id, epic_id, turn_id, context_snapshot (json: {user_message, bot_action_being_critiqued}), active (default true), deactivation_reason, resolved (default false), resolution_note, resolved_at, created_at, last_referenced_at, last_applied_at

Two semantic groups:
- User feedback (style, process, epic_specific) — active → deactivated; tracked via last_applied_at
- Agent observations (friction, ambiguity, tool_failure, confusion, pattern_noticed) — open → resolved; tracked via resolved_at

## Acceptance Criteria

- "change the part about X" → bot calls search_in_body, then get_epic for matching section, then edit_epic (verifiable via tool_calls sequence)
- get_body_outline returns section names + line counts matching actual body
- "stop apologizing" → bot proposes saving as style feedback, user confirms, row written; subsequent turn honors it via hot context
- "save this: keep messages under 200 words" → bot saves immediately (explicit save)
- apply_feedback(id) → last_applied_at updated
- record_observation(kind='friction', ...) → row written with turn_id and context_snapshot; surfaces in hot context next turn
- mark_observation_resolved(id, "user clarified") → resolved_at set, not in hot context
- "Show me the epic" → render_epic called
- End-of-turn check fires when bot tries to finish without sending message → default acknowledgment

## Tests
- Unit: search_in_body returns correct results; get_body_outline accuracy; feedback kind detection; end-of-turn check logic; observation writes
- Integration: feedback save → apply → reload; observation recorded → reload → resolved
- LLM-graded eval: 20 fixture turns with style violations; 20 turns checking body for filler
